comment: “Other governmental agencies that own and govern DPI-F” assumes that foundational DPI is owned and governed by government agencies. Some countries use public corporations, regulated private operators, shared regional services, or public-private arrangements.

public.text: “Other governmental agencies that own and govern DPI-F” assumes that foundational DPI is owned and governed by government agencies. Some countries use public corporations, regulated private operators, shared regional services, or public-private arrangements.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace with a sentence like: “Authorities and accountable operators responsible for foundational or cross-sector digital public infrastructure.”
